data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step: BOOK, Map search, origin, search type, flexible dates, Search, then opening a result from the list. It also uses the same three parameters. It loses a point on feasibility because it marks search type and flexible dates as optional and doesn't spell out their allowed values or how to select them.
